LanguageData.FB_FleshNecrosisText:
A patch of the cover has died. The tissue there has gone grey and slack, and the rot is creeping outward through living cover, one cell at a time.

Buildings on dead tissue are cut off from the hemogel network and fall apart, flesh walls on it rot through, grasping tendrils no longer grow there and no flora comes up.

There is nothing to fight. Mark the rot with the Fleshmass Floor Remove Plan and the colony will digest it away. The rot spreads by contact alone, so cutting a ring of living cover around it will also hold it in place - but it still has to be eaten to be gone.
LanguageData.FB_FleshNecrosisCleared: The necrosis has been digested away; nothing is spreading any more.
